text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone... thank you... for cheering today."
—Aand, done!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, my love power is at maximum! ♡
I have to do my best—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah, my childhood friend.
Cheering me on, saying they'll be watching.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'm always overflowing with love from my community members, but now I've gotten even more love♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
All right, I feel like I could run
amazingly right now! I'm gonna give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the cheers from her fans and childhood friend, Loves Only You's fighting spirit burns even brighter.
We can expect a great race from her!
